text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed the OpenAPI examples for POST /v1/generate are inconsistent with the request/response schemas. Example payload uses `max_new_tokens` but the spec expects `max_tokens`. Also the response example still shows an old `choices` shape instead of the new `data`/`text` shape.

maria: Oh no. Is that from the docs PR we merged yesterday? which file?

alex: Yep, https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/438 — the file is docs/reference/generate.md. The curl/python snippets are wrong and the JSON sample in the response section is outdated. Caught while testing the new Python SDK snippet generator.

ken: I can take this. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) `max_tokens` is an integer, correct? 2) Do we want to keep a compatibility note for `max_new_tokens` users?

maria: 1) integer, yes. 2) Add a 1-line migration note: "Older clients may send `max_new_tokens`; the server will map it to `max_tokens` but please update callers to use `max_tokens`." Keep it brief.

alex: Proposed example patch below — replace the request example and response example. Also update the Python snippet to use `max_tokens`.

alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-medium",
    "input": "Summarize the following text:",
    "max_tokens": 120,
    "temperature": 0.2
  }'
```

alex: And a minimal Python snippet:```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"]) 
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-medium", input="Summarize...", max_tokens=120)
print(resp.data[0].text)
```

alex: And example response to match schema:```json
{
  "id": "gen_01H6...",
  "object": "generation",
  "model": "redwood-medium",
  "data": [
    {"text": "Short summary...", "index": 0}
  ],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 18, "total_tokens": 30}
}
```

docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/438 (build 2024-11-02_14:22)

ken: Thanks — I'll open a branch and update docs/reference/generate.md, docs/snippets/python/generate.md, and CHANGES.md. Will also update the OpenAPI sample object under src/openapi/generate.yaml to match. Pushing in a few mins: branch `docs/fix-openapi-gen-examples`.

maria: :thumbsup: please include the migration note and mention that the embedding example elsewhere also used `max_new_tokens` incorrectly. Tag @eng-runtime for awareness in the PR description.

alex: Great — I'll review once CI finishes. Thanks!
